_comment: Copy to ~/.config/prboard/config.json and edit. gate_rules is the editable checklist: add/remove entries to add/remove conditions — no code changes. A rule fires when ALL predicates in 'when' match; action 'manual' = you handle it, 'skip' = ignore the PR.
_discovery_window_hours: Only consider PRs updated in the last N hours. Evaluating one PR costs ~6 GitHub calls, so this is the main lever on how long a run takes. 0 = no window. Override per-run with --since-hours.

_gate_predicates_reference.title_regex: a regex matched against the PR title

_act_on_advisory_checks: A red check only blocks a merge when the base branch requires it; GitHub says so via mergeable_state == 'unstable'. prboard reports those as CHECKS_ADVISORY instead of CHECKS_FAILED. Leave this false and they are shown but never auto-approved; set true to act on them.
_allow_no_checks: A commit with no checks reported is treated as CHECKS_PENDING, not green — on a fresh push CI needs a moment to register. Set true only for repos that genuinely have no CI.
